summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the postponement of its Extraordinary General Meeting originally called for May 28, 2026, to June 8, 2026. The EGM was convened in connection with a shareholding transaction involving Petrobras and Shine I Fundo de Investimento e Participações (FIP). Agenda items include amending bylaws to reflect a new Shareholders' Agreement and electing Board members. The postponement is due to unmet conditions, including judicial authorizations. The filing is a routine procedural update concerning meeting logistics and governance changes, not a standalone special situation event.
